content:
Apple TV has just added a batch of classic movies for subscribers, just before the strong fall lineup arrives.

Apple TV is rushing to expand its library again before the heavyweight fall lineup arrives, adding a batch of movies.

Recently, the film industry has been abuzz with hot topics. Box office hits such as "Blossom Apple," "Spider-Man: Brand New Day," and "Obsession" have all sparked cultural phenomena, and the overall film market is also showing strong momentum.

It looks like Apple wants a piece of the pie too.

Apple TV has added a large number of acclaimed movies for free to subscribers this week. The specific lineup varies slightly by region, but US viewers can find "The Martian," "Arrival," "Eye in the Sky," "The Big Sick," "Memories of Murder," and "21 Jump Street," among other titles.

With the addition of this batch of new movies, Apple's library has almost doubled overnight.

Apple's acquisition of these movie rights does not mean it has given up on its own original films. In fact, this batch of new films has arrived just in time before the densely packed fall release schedule.

Below are six new films coming to Apple TV this fall:

  • September 4: "Mayday"
  • October 2: "The Last First: Winter K2"
  • October 9: "Matchbox The Movie"
  • October 16: "Tenzing"
  • November 13: "Being Heumann"
  • November 25: "Way of the Warrior Kid"

Apple has always been trying to strike a balance between "awards-bait films" and "mainstream entertainment films." It looks like this fall, the ratio is roughly fifty-fifty.

"Mayday," "Matchbox," and "Way of the Warrior Kid" all look like lighthearted action comedies starring the likes of Ryan Reynolds and John Cena; while "Being Heumann," "Tenzing," and "The Last First" are clearly aimed at awards season.

Apple has always performed outstandingly on the television side — the recent return of "Ted Lasso" is the best example. Whether its ambitions in film can achieve the same success remains to be seen.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or can be bundled with other services through Apple One for a discounted subscription.
